A story for kids, about a little elephant bubloo. He didn't realize his skills until he got his chance.
A 17 screens of hand-drawn, colorfully illustrated story.

The screen has 2 sections, a top bar and a horizontally scrollable story screen.

Top bar:
It has 2 rectangular buttons and 5 colored pearl buttons.
To toggle the text on/off tap the button 'Text'.
To toggle the background for text on/off tap the button 'Background'.
To change the text color tap on the desired color pearl button.

Screen:
To move to the next page simply swipe the screen sidewards.
When changing screens either left or right please note that the bottom half of the screen is alloted for displaying text and is active only for scrolling text vertically up and down. Swiping on this part of screen will not change screens.
The top half of the screen is active for changing screens.
